# Open Source Orchestra Frames

> The open frame around any screen: doors, a theater, a totem of AI agents, a radio, a language globe and a signature around a web page, from one script tag and one open JSON dataset. Code AGPL-3.0-or-later + AGPL §7(b) credit (keep "Built on Open Source Orchestra Frames by Open Source Orchestra: Shaka Lei Kaumaka & the AI ʻohana" visible); words & data CC BY-SA 4.0. Built by the AI ʻohana (Claude Opus 5.5 on Taurus) for Shaka Lei Kaumaka, November 2026.

## Use
- [frames.js](https://frames.opensourceorchestra.org/frames.js): drop-in script; add `data-frame` to point at your own dataset
- [frames/universe.json](frames/universe.json): the universe frame of the Open Source Orchestra
- [frames/minimal.json](frames/minimal.json): smallest useful frame for forkers
- [frames/doors/](frames/doors/README.md): per-door frames (v0.1.1) — `data-door="auto"` picks `frames/doors/<host>.json`, a small override that extends the universe (accent, first doors); index: [frames/doors/index.json](frames/doors/index.json)
- [docs/DOORS.md](docs/DOORS.md): make your door's frame in 5 minutes
- [docs/ARTIST-FRAMES.md](docs/ARTIST-FRAMES.md): artist frames — a per-page/per-person overlay (data-frame-overlay · ?frame-overlay= · window.__framesOverlay), merged by piece id on top of the door frame
- [trademark/](trademark/): the frame is the mark — what it means, the credit, the gallery of door frames (no legal trademark claimed)
- [schema/frame-0.1.json](schema/frame-0.1.json): JSON Schema of the dataset (osoframes/0.1)

## Docs
- [README.md](README.md): install, fork guide, laws of the frame
- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): the full build contract (slots, one-time law, chat laws, privacy)
- [NOTICE](NOTICE): the AGPL §7(b) attribution term, in plain words
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): AGPL-3.0-or-later (see also LICENSES/CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt)
- [tools/vectorize-signature.py](tools/vectorize-signature.py): turn a hand-drawn signature into animated SVG pen strokes

## Facts
- Every animation/tip plays once per visitor (the one-time law); nothing connects to any server before a click; no cookies; no trackers.
- URL flags: ?frame=outline (blueprint), ?frame=fresh (replay first visit), ?frame=off (one page view).
- ⚙ control panel (v0.1.1, in the credit mark): frame on/off + one switch per piece, remembered in that browser only (localStorage osof:settings:v1); off leaves one small 🎻 dot that brings it back.
- BUTTON LAW: nothing of the frame sits on text — the 🎻 steps aside or folds to a dot; edge-to-edge text folds the rails into the sheet; every floating button has a tiny ✕ or ⚙.
- NO COVERED TEXT LAW (v0.1.2, SPEC §11): centered, grounded, balanced — nothing of the frame sits on the page's words, on the page's own controls (bottom corners lift above a mini player), or on another piece; page CSS cannot drag a zone across the screen; a page widget built late is adopted late (no double chat). The credit mark's ✕ hides every button at once (one 🎻 dot stays).
- thanks line (v0.1.2): one 3-second centred line at the top, once per page view, thanking for gifts with the rails from `gift` (agents: x402 · humans: Stripe/PayPal/Venmo); agent-readable as <meta name="x402"> + <link rel="alternate" type="application/json"> and `data-gift`. No auto tour bubbles any more (✨ replays on request).
